citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
The facility has an environment enhancement plan for the chickens that they use to have, but they do not have a
documented environment enhancement plan for the barred owl. Not having a documented environment enhancement
plan for the barred owl approved by the attending veterinarian doesn't ensure the psychological well-being of the bird is
being met. The licensee must have a documented environment enhancement plan for the barred owl that has been
approved by the attending veterinarian. Correct by 7/24/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
End of report.
